entries.message:
Hey there! Here are some cool updates from the Core team :okak:

_Apple Retention Messaging_ :money-smell:

• New metrics per message: Saved users, Save rate (no cancel within 24h) and Saved revenue. You see whether a message works the next day, not after the next billing.
• Title above the image in Default messages (Apple’s headerPosition) <!subteam^S07BZPQDBUJ> I remember some of your clients asked about it.

Docs: <https://adapty.io/docs/retention-messaging-analytics|adapty.io/docs/retention-messaging-analytics> <https://adapty.io/docs/retention-messaging-create#content|adapty.io/docs/retention-messaging-create#…>

_What’s next & coming soon:_ overview charts, bullet images, metrics by product and offer, segmentation, A/B tests of messages, clearer message and locale statuses. Stay tuned :eyes:

_SmakApps requests about A/B testing_ :handshake:

SmakApps re-signed with a list of A/B asks due by the end of Q4. Everything Core owed for the contract renewal is in prod: Users and Installs per A/B variant, test, variant and Flow in purchase events for integrations, fixes for Duplicate and drafts, View metrics for archived tests. <@U07H1ESAH6K> fyi

Huge thanks to <@U0ACSQAKJA1> <@U08ASB4GYR4> <@U0A3M160RB4> <@U0AQZG23D62>

entries.name: hey guyys! day of the releases I see :)
entries.message:
hey guyys! day of the releases I see :)
so we released two things today in flow-builder

1. first one is the 12mo commitment plan!
it is fully supported inside flow builder, so
you can set it up in minutes and use it in ur flow, huge hopes on this one!
example is on screen 1

huge kudos here <@U0BB5T65SF6> and <@U07J9LKBQ5U> for pushing it and helping me to bring it to users

2. second one is very important to flow builder stability plan, as many of you know we had big issues with how flows render in web and on mobile, and team did a really great job with bringing flow builder to the state we have now, and today we finally ship one of the biggest pieces of that plan: on mobile, flows are now laid out with native stacks instead of grids

what this means to users: until now, the transformer turned every container into a grid and had to guess the size of each element (how tall a text is, how wide a block is) before the SDK ever drew it, when a guess was off, the device showed something different from what you built: blocks shifted, text got cut off, empty space appeared in odd places, and iOS and Android often disagreed with each other. now every container maps to a SDK stack that just have more flexibility and allows us to build flows more reliably
screenshot number two is just an example how much better it is now.
it is not a silver bullet, and we still have a loads of work ahead of us, but it is another great leap towards big beautiful builder
and it is not a UI change, it is purely about how builder builts flows

huge thanks to <@U09UZ0GJYKE>, she helped me a lot to push it through
and of course <@U08EVBTE69E>, Max supported me on the stability plan all the way through, and huge kudos to him as well!

entries.name: :rocket: *New in Flow metrics: Flow screen funnel*
entries.message:
:rocket: *New in Flow metrics: Flow screen funnel*
You can now see on which screen of a flow users drop off and where they buy. Flow metrics has a new *Funnel* tab.
*What’s inside*
• *Summary:* how many users started the flow (Entered), how many finished it (Completed), the share that dropped off (Drop rate), and the flow’s revenue (Revenue)
• *Step table:* how many users reached each screen, how many finished the flow there, and how many dropped off. Paywall screens also show trials, purchases and revenue
• *Branches:* a step with several screens expands, so you can see how many users each screen got
• *Chart:* a bar per step, conversion between steps, and drop-off under each step
• *Filters:* date range, install date mode, Country, Store, Platform, Subscription state. You can pick any published version of the flow
• *CSV export*
*How Completed is counted*
A user completes the flow when they buy or start a trial on a paywall, or reach the last screen. If the last screen is a paywall, only users who bought count. Everyone else is a drop-off on the screen where they left.
*Good to know*
• The funnel is built for the currently published version by default, so Entered can be lower than the views on the Metrics tab, which counts all versions
Where to find it: Flows → your flow → Flow metrics → *Funnel* tab
Thanks <@U033TEH5HSA> for building it :raised_hands:
FYI <@U08EVBTE69E>

entries.name: hey team! excited to share a great AI update with you :robot_face:
entries.message:
hey team! excited to share a great AI update with you :robot_face:
something we were building quietly and finally got unlocked due to <https://adapty-team.slack.com/archives/C04SY70QZ0T/p1792685168191469|CLI analytics release above>

i bet you remember that we had Autopilot product. which allows users to get insights on their app - based on the benchmarks and our growth knowledge. it was born because apps want expertise and assistance from adapty, and we have it - 30k apps data

main reasons why autopilot didn't skyrocket - we generated growth ideas, but they *1) weren't that new (or crazy) for big apps*; 2) *ideas still required execution*, and based on custdevs - that was the problem. no one wants to do manual job to run hundreds of AB tests - segments, paywalls, products, analytics -> repeat

what i am presenting to you today = *Growth advisor skill for CLI - v1* :rocket:

it is an extremely smart skill with growth manager expertise and more: 1) knowledge and expertise of our PS team with thousands of AB tests (trust me there is a lot); 2) per industry benchmarks from our latest reports: and 3) understanding of the whole adapty growth setup via CLI (ABs/segments/placements/flow builder etc.)

*we now will finally close the whole loop, because agents are too good now. which is mind-blowing* :chefs-kiss:
1. *Analysis*
    a. you ask agent with our new skill everything =  "please audit my whole app" or "I have two ideas: a weekly plan OR a new placement. Which one should I test first?"
    b. it reads everything - your revenue/conversion by countries, placement-structure of your app, history of AB tests, your main products 
2. *Hypothesis/ideas (via skill)*
    a. it gives you ideas on what you should focus on based on our benchmarks and expertise, but you can chat/discuss and argue (something we lacked in autopilot v1)
3. *Preparation (via CLI)*
    a. you can easily (!) set up any idea you like without interface! thanks to AI team and our CLI there! 
    b. you have an idea to run AB test where you localise paywall for brazilian market and compare yearly for 40$ VS 50$ 
        i. Agent will do the magic: create a segment for Brazil, generate a paywall (in flow builder) with the new prices, and create a draft of AB test
4. *Execution*
    a. User just reviews it, and then launches the AB. just him, claude code and adapty CLI. 
In the end - *Adapty helps you - delegate growth to us, while focusing on other things. everything is agentic, as the market requires* :dart:

*it's v1 now. to become fully agentic growth manager* - we have things coming in the nearest days:
• AB tests analysis & set up
• pulling and updating the prices of each product, with the pricing index of adapty included
• hypothesis list - you can "save" hypothesis you like (and see them in the frontend of adapty dashboard. a piece of "human in the loop" (p3)
read more and install here:
<https://adapty.io/docs/export-analytics-with-ai|adapty.io/docs/export-analytics-with-ai>

we are entering new era now. huge thanks to <@U08QUJMN0UV> <@U080G9FHV50> <@U0AKC1Y09R8> <@U08JY3U9S7P> and AI team <@U0ALSG3VA30> <@U07J1NQPD4P>

entries.name: Apple’s 12-month commitment plans are LIVE, finally!!! :money-smell:
entries.message:
Apple’s 12-month commitment plans are LIVE, finally!!! :money-smell:

<!subteam^S03KC9S1QMC> <!subteam^S07BZPQDBUJ>

iOS SDK 4.3.0 lets apps sell a yearly subscription as 12 monthly payments, priced up to 50% above upfront. A cancel only stops the next commitment: the user keeps paying until payment 12.

• Custom paywalls: add the yearly product with Billing plan = Monthly. Users who can’t buy the plan (US, iOS below 26.4, older app versions) get the upfront price.
• Analytics, webhooks and integrations report the plan as `<product_id>:monthly`. Customers who match on product ID in their backend need to update it before the first purchase.
• No grace period: after a failed payment the user has no access until Apple recovers it.
Limits for now: native iOS only (cross-platform SDKs target early November), and Flows can’t show the plan yet.

Docs:
• <https://adapty.io/docs/app-store-12-month-commitment|adapty.io/docs/app-store-12-month-commitment>
• <https://adapty.io/docs/set-up-12-month-commitment|adapty.io/docs/set-up-12-month-commitment>

entries.name: hey team! light & dark themes are live in flow builder :jack_o_lantern::crescent_moon:
entries.message:
hey team! light & dark themes are live in flow builder :jack_o_lantern::crescent_moon:

until now: dark mode in flows could swap only plain colors. images, gradients and videos stayed the same at night, so paywalls migrated from the old builder lost their dark look :skull:

What's new:
• color styles hold a separate stack for Light and Dark - solid, gradient, image or video, layered
• Image and Video elements got Light / Dark tabs - drop a night file next to the day one. don't need two? one file serves both themes
• the switcher under the canvas previews both themes, the tabs follow it
• localizations show Light and Dark rows, so every language can have its own day and night picture :spider_web:
• no SDK update needed - the app picks the dark file when the phone is in dark mode

Who's been waiting for it :bat:
• Impala - day/night images and gradients in styles, their footer gradient got lost after the migration
• Jaumo - WeightBuddy funnels with different images and gradients per theme
• Tappz - a gradient over a dark mode background
• Weewoo - day and night assets for images and videos
and many more!

limits for now :new_moon:
• text color takes solid layers only - gradients and images there are skipped with a warning
• icons and shadows stay one solid per theme, input borders one solid or gradient

thanks to <@U07PR2368G5> for the design, <@U09UZ0GJYKE> for testing it inside out and <@U0A4F2RSMQQ> for the reviews and color fixes :spider:

entries.name: *Сustom fonts in flow builder are now families*
entries.message:
*Сustom fonts in flow builder are now families*

before: one font = one file
you could pick Bold for a font with only Regular uploaded - the preview faked it, the phone showed Regular
clients found out only after publishing

now:
• upload all the weights at once - they group into one family by themselves
• the weight menu shows only what you uploaded, so preview = device
• one variable file gives every weight on iOS and Android :sparkles:

Small update on flow-generator

When there's no design to follow (no design reference in prompt/other flows/app code), paywalls used to come out as the same template every time: comparison table, two plan cards, a button. Now the skill invents a few ideas from the app's world and picks one. Then, it builds it and checks its own screenshot: if the screen slid back into the template, got too busy, or hid the plans below the fold, it rebuilds.

Onboardings got data too: now, their length differs by category, and the flow follows a rhythm: no more than three questions in a row, then a reaction or a "how it works" screen, so a long flow doesn't feel like a form.

:rocket: New in Adapty Ads Manager: *Change History!*

Change History shows customers every change made in their Apple Ads account: what changed, when, who made it.
What’s new:
• A full log of changes to campaigns, ad groups, keywords, ads and other settings, with exact before-and-after values
• Available in
    ◦ :robot_face: Adapty for AI Agents (CLI), so an agent can answer “what changed yesterday and who did it”
    ◦ :page_facing_up: A separate Change History page with filters
    ◦ :chart_with_upwards_trend: Keyword detailed charts
• It includes changes made outside Adapty: in Apple’s own dashboard, by other tools or scripts, and by Apple Support

When a metric jumps, the cause is usually someone’s action, not the market. For agencies and teams with several people and tools in one account, this answers “who changed it” without asking around.

hey team!

entries.name: RevenueCat Migrator is live :male_mage:
entries.message:
RevenueCat Migrator is live :male_mage:
<!subteam^S03KC9S1QMC> <!subteam^S07BZPQDBUJ> <!subteam^S03KM96DV0U> <@U0ASX4X3CKZ> <@U06K36L6CTB> <@U05QELDHUUX>

Developers on RevenueCat can now ask their coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) to move their app to Adapty. The agent works through the Adapty CLI, and RevenueCat keeps running until the new app version ships.

How to try it:
1. Create a RevenueCat secret API key: V2, Read only on project configuration.
2. Run `npm install -g adapty` and `adapty auth login` in the agent’s terminal.
3. Tell the agent “Migrate my RevenueCat project to a new Adapty app called Acme with the Adapty CLI”. Paste the key into the Adapty page it opens and answer its mapping questions.
4. Ask for the rest with one prompt each: paywall designs, app code, integrations, store events. Then test a sandbox purchase and release.
Docs: <https://adapty.io/docs/migration-from-revenuecat|adapty.io/docs/migration-from-revenuecat>

How it works:
• We read the RC catalog through their API and recreate it in Adapty: entitlements as access levels, offerings as placements with a paywall or a Flow. IDs stay the same, so `entitlements["premium"]` becomes `accessLevels["premium"]` and the code diff stays small.
• Adapty receives App Store notifications and forwards them to RC. On Google Play it joins RC’s Pub/Sub topic as a second subscriber, so both backends get every renewal and refund during the switch.
• The agent swaps the SDK and code on an `adapty-migrate` branch and lists the manual steps in ADAPTY_SETUP.md. It also rebuilds RC paywalls as Adapty Flows and finds analytics and attribution SDKs in the code.
• Transaction history comes over through Amazon S3. Each migration gets its own bucket and an IAM role that only RevenueCat can assume, using the External ID from their export settings, and that role can only write. RC sends a daily Cloud Export there. We check for new files every hour, import only products from the migrated catalog and re-validate each transaction with the store. A week after the first file we close the migration and delete the bucket.
• The migration runs as a state machine on our server, and the CLI only shows the next step. We can ship new steps without a CLI release. Keys go straight into the Adapty dashboard, so the agent never sees them.
Huge thanks to <@U09L1SS03B8><@U08QUJMN0UV> <@U08ASB4GYR4> <@U0AQZG23D62> <@U0ACSQAKJA1> <@U09AH7D2A4X> <@U0AR243M9T9>

entries.message:
hey team! custom tags are live in flow builder :jack_o_lantern:

one of the last pieces for parity with the legacy builder :crystal_ball:

Maybe everyone knows what is it but anyway:
a text variable whose value comes from the app, not from the flow
the developer passes it by name at runtime - user name, coin balance, current plan, anything the app knows and we don't
so the screen says "Hi, Anna! your marathon plan is ready" instead of "Hi there!" :ghost:

How it works:
create a variable, tick "Value comes from outside the app", drop it into any text
Initial value is what you see on the canvas
and it's also what the user sees if the app doesn't send the tag - the line never breaks, no spooky empty spots :spider_web:

Who's been waiting for it :bat:
• Feeld - one Majestic paywall with a title and description set by entry point: "See who liked you" when opened from likes, "Become Majestic" from the account tab. they were waiting for tags to move it to flows
• Ideawise - want to show the user's current plan price next to the offer, so the upgrade gap is obvious
• Crsel - a social proof paywall with the real number of users on the annual plan. without tags they'd have to hardcode it for the A/B test
• and it all started with sales asking if a paywall can show the user's coin balance :candy:

limits for now :skull:
• text only - no conditions, alerts or URLs yet. app values in logic is the next task

thanks to <@U08EVBTE69E>:spider:

entries.name: hey team! two Adapty Mail updates in one video :movie_camera:
entries.message:
hey team! two Adapty Mail updates in one video :movie_camera:

1. Domain Health :stethoscope:
Every sending domain now has its own health page (Settings → DNS → Details). Customers can see where their mail stands before a mailbox provider tells them.

- Deliverability score: one number from 0 to 100 plus a status (Healthy, Needs attention or At risk). We build it from complaints, hard bounces and inbox rate, so one bad signal can't hide behind two good ones
- Inbox placement: inbox vs. spam for each provider (Gmail, Yahoo, iCloud...). We measure it daily on our seed mailboxes
- Bounces: why emails bounce, hard vs. soft, and which provider bounces the most. We drop hard bounces from sending automatically
- Send tiers: the domain's step on the warmup ladder (20 tiers, 100 to 57,000 emails a day) and today's sending limit

Why it matters: if emails land in spam, the whole channel stops working. Until now customers had to take our word that everything was fine. Now they can check it themselves and catch problems early.

2. Email localization :globe_with_meridians:
One campaign covers every language, so nobody has to clone campaigns and segments per country anymore.

- Hit Localize, pick languages (79 available), done. The translation keeps the brand voice, and the layout, buttons and links stay as they were
- Each user gets the email in their device language. If we don't have a translation for that language, they get the English version, so the email always renders correctly
- Works for every campaign type, transactional ones too (double opt-in, app activation)
- You can add a language to a live campaign without relaunching it. People already in the flow keep the language they started with
- When you edit the English email, we mark its translations as Outdated, and one click re-localizes them

kudos to <@U04B26DSWMA> and <@UNWFN144R>

We also signed our first contract yesterday (with AIBY) and started to add first new revenue to our FF clients this week.

entries.message:
hey team!
*You can now attach images in the Flow Agent chat* :frame_with_picture:
Until now you could only message the agent with text, so "make it like this" had to be explained in words. Now you can just show it.

*What you can do:*
• *Reference:* drop a screenshot and ask "make a similar screen." The agent builds the screen from builder elements in similar colors.
• *Your own image in the flow:* "set this as the background / hero / icon," and the image goes into an image element.
• *Screen feedback:* "this button looks off here, fix it," and the agent fixes the visuals.
Attach with the button or drag and drop into the chat. The agent remembers images in later messages of the thread, so you don't need to resend them.

*Not there yet, but coming soon:*
• *The agent doesn't generate images. If the reference has an illustration that isn't among the attachments, you'll get a placeholder or icons in its place.*
• One thread works with one screen, so three screenshots won't turn into three screens.
Give it a try and share your feedback :raised_hands:

_Huge thanks to <@U0ALSG3VA30> and <@U080G9FHV50> for building this_ :purple_heart:
